==About==

A {{i|Sugar Treat}} is the product of a first growth stage, second tier {{i|Pumpkin}} Harvest. Additionally a Sugar Treat can be grown by Planting another Sugar Treat in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. Planting in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. Right-clicking a Sugar Treat and selecting "Slice" will give you 2x {{i|Pumpkin Flesh}} and 6x {{i|Seeds of Pumpkin}}. A Sugar Treat can be stored in a {{i|Stockbin}}.
